scenes.text: Identify, explain and apply the important ideas behind setting bookmarks.
Theme: changes the appearance of a browser. Bookmark: saves a useful page link.
Default search engine: is the service a browser uses for searches. Cookies: are small pieces of information stored by sites. Settings: control how the browser behaves.
Use an imaginary example or a teacher-approved offline screenshot. Discuss when to use theme and bookmark. Never enter a real password or share private details in this activity.
